option_relations.rationale: Post-inflammatory atrophic scars are a general descriptive term for scars that result from inflammation, but Discoid lupus erythematosus is a specific autoimmune disease.
Atrophia maculosa varioliformis cutis (AMVC) is a specific idiopathic atrophic skin condition. Discoid lupus erythematosus is an autoimmune disease with different characteristics.
Atrophoderma of Pasini and Pierini is a form of dermal atrophy, often considered a variant of morphea. Discoid lupus erythematosus is a distinct autoimmune connective tissue disease.

Anetoderma is characterized by localized areas of flaccid skin due to loss of dermal elastic tissue. Discoid lupus erythematosus is an autoimmune disease with different primary pathology and clinical presentation.
